query_info.key_query: SELECT B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID || '_' || B.AMSYS_BLBR_DTL_ID AS "docid" , B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID AS "blbrId" , B.AMSYS)BLBR_DTL_ID AS "blbrDtlId" FROM SGEOWN.MSGE004ITM A, SGEOWN.MSGE005ITF B WHERE 1=1 AND A.AMSYS_BLBR_ID = B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID AND B.DAT_USG_YN='Y' AND A.AMSYS_BLBR_KDCD=1 -- 공지사항:1, 게시판:2 AND B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID = :blbrId AND B.AMSYS_BLBR_DTL_ID = :blbrDtlId ORDER BY B.UPPD_FIX_YN DESC, B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID DESC, B.BLTN_SORT_SEQ_NO DESC
query_info.data_query: SELECT B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID || '_' || B.AMSYS_BLBR_DTL_ID AS "docid" , 'rptlvks' AS "category_full" , 20000 AS "collapse_cd" , A.AMSYS_BLBR_KDCD AS "blbrKdcd" , B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID AS "blbrId" , B.AMSYS)BLBR_DTL_ID AS "blbrDtlId" , B.AMSYS_BIZ_CFCD AS "bizCfcd" , B.B:BR_BLTN_TITL_TXT AS "title" , B.AMSYS_BLBR_BLTNTXT AS "content" , B.HGRN_BLBR_DTL_ID AS "upprBlbrDtlId" , B.AMSYS_ATFL_ID AS "atflId" , B.BLTN_SORT_SEQ_NO AS "sortSeqNo" , B.BLBR_RGPE_NO AS "blbrRplsNo" , B.ANC_RGPE_NM AS "writer_nm" , SUBSTR(B.BLTN_TEM_END_DT,0,4)||'_'||'-'||SUBSTR(B.BLTN_TEM_END_DT,7,2) AS "end_dtm" , B.UPPO_FIX_YN AS "uppoFixYn" , SUBSTR(B.FST_DB_RGS_DTM,0,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(B.FST_DB_RGS_DTM,5,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(B.FST_DB_RGS_DTM,7,2) AS "reg_dtm" , SUBSTR(B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,0,4) || '-'|| SUBSTR(B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,5,2)||'_'||SUBSTR(B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,7,2) AS "upd_dtm" FROM SGEOWN.MSGE004ITM A, SGEOWN.MSGE005ITF B WHERE 1=1 AND A.AMSYS_BLBR_ID = B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID AND B.DAT_USG_YN='Y' AND A.AMSYS_BLBR_KDCD=1 -- 공지사항:1, 게시판:2 AND B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID = :blbrId AND B.AMSYS_BLBR_DTL_ID = :blbrDtlId ORDER BY B.UPPD_FIX_YN DESC, B.AMSYS_BLBR_ID DESC, B.BLTN_SORT_SEQ_NO DESC
